line_semantics.direction: source swaps complete endpoints when x0>x1; emits left-to-right
line_semantics.x_major_tie: advance minor y only when accumulated minor exceeds floor(major/2)
line_semantics.y_major_tie: advance minor x only when accumulated minor exceeds floor(major/2)
line_semantics.degenerate: one pixel; vertical lines use the source dedicated byte-column loop
line_semantics.cursor_pretest: g_4333=0 may hide cursor for a bounding-box overlap; it does not clip the line
line_semantics.framebuffer: normalized VGA write stream is replayed into a zero-origin 640x480 indexed buffer; no VGA planar hardware is emulated
